sqlMap.select: SELECT KEY_7 AS TOKEN FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'TOKEN' AND TARGET = 'KRSK--G001'

SELECT PLANT, BUYER_ITEM_NO, STATUS, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, UNIT_PRICE, DELIVERY_LT, DATA01 AS MOD_DIV, DATA02 AS REQ_DIV FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND WHERE BUYER IN ('KRSK--G001','KRSK--G002') AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND SET IF_FLAG = #flag#, IF_MSG = #msg# WHERE BUYER IN ('KRSK--G001','KRSK--G002') AND PLANT = #plant# AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = #buyer_item_no# AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_IT_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER IN ('KRSK--G001','KRSK--G002') AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
